title: Compaction entry the engine wrote
description: A compaction entry whose details are the engine's (om.folded). In Pi/PiG the host stores it from the compaction the extension returned; the neutral host stores it itself after its om.cut marker. A compaction whose details are not om.folded (a host's native summary, the TypeScript extension's old details) is not the engine's and is out of this schema: the engine reads it as an unbacked summary (extract.HostSummary). Source: memory/neutral/compact.go (Host.compact), memory/hooks/compaction_hook.go (CompactionResult.ToMap), memory/ledger/types.go (MemoryDetails).
